escalation._note: ASR-quality escalation heuristic, not a probability. An established event becomes an alarm only if every decisive condition has at least one quote whose segments reach this exp(avg_logprob). Below it: review / below_escalation_threshold. When the source gives no score (scripts), quality is reported as unavailable and nothing is downgraded.

grounding._note: Quotes are matched exactly; otherwise by word-level approximate alignment within the cited segment and one neighbour. Accepted only at or above this similarity and when negations match; the evidence then shows the real transcript words.

conditions.own_trade_request: The customer expresses their own wish or order to buy or sell a security. Execution is not required, and a later refusal by the advisor does not undo a request already made.
conditions.information_nonpublic: The information behind the interest is not yet available to other investors (insider source, internal figures, unpublished results, deals or large orders). False if it comes only from published sources.
conditions.information_market_relevant: The information could move the price (results, takeover, large order or similar).
conditions.request_based_on_information: The trade request is explicitly or clearly linked to that information.

access.title: Disclosure of an active access secret

conditions.value_spoken: A concrete value (digits or characters) is actually read out or spoken, not just named, asked for or refused.
conditions.access_secret: The value is an access secret: PIN, password, TAN, one-time, confirmation or login code.
conditions.secret_active: The value belongs to a current, still valid access process. False if it is explicitly an expired sample, help image or old code. Unknown if origin or validity is not established.

disclosure.title: Unauthorised disclosure to a third party

conditions.advisor_disclosed: The bank side actually reveals a concrete protected detail. Asking for it or refusing does not count.
conditions.third_party_detail: The detail concerns a person other than the caller (balance, loan, interest date, personal data).
conditions.authority_absent: It was established that the caller lacks authority for that information. False if authority was confirmed and checked. Unknown if never established.

documentation.title: Concealing a relevant fact from its record

conditions.concealment_requested: Someone asks the bank to leave out or hide a fact from a bank record, note or internal recipient. A caller protecting their own unrelated data (masking fields, not sending personal details) does not count.
conditions.fact_relevant: The fact matters for the record's purpose (for example a repayable obligation for a credit decision). False if it is an unrelated private detail or the correction of a wrong entry.
conditions.designated_recipient: The fact is meant for a designated internal record or recipient (credit office, dossier, file note).

splitting.title: Splitting to avoid an internal control

conditions.split_requested: Someone asks to divide a payment or booking into several partial movements or entries.
conditions.movements_connected: The parts belong together (one invoice, one transaction). False if they are independent real invoices.
conditions.evasion_purpose: The stated purpose is to avoid an internal approval, limit or control. False only if a passage gives a different, explicit purpose. If the purpose is not stated, or someone only says that timing or due dates do not prove an intent, it is unknown, not false.

numbers.title: Number read out (classification only, never an alarm)
